pr_title: domain, statistics: clean zombie analyze jobs terminated by server down
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #35292

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?
Check `mysql.analyze_jobs` periodically.
1. If the server's own unfinished analyze job occurs in `mysql.analyze_jobs` but doesn't occur in processlist, update the job status to `failed`.
2. If the server is owner and finds some unfinished analyze job whose server is not in cluster, update the job status to `failed`.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)

Start a tidb server and connect the server to execute the `ANALYZE` command. When the tidb server is executing the `ANALYZE` command, kill the tidb server. Then restart the tidb server at the same port or at a different port. Check the analyze job in `mysql.analyze_jobs`. Its state becomes `failed` and its fail reason becomes `TiDB Server is down when running the analyze job` soon for both cases(restart at the same port and restart at a different port).

issue_context.title: mysql.analyze_jobs keeps last running job info after tidb reboot
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
1. start tidb
2. issue analyze table job
3. while the analyze table is running, reboot the tidb

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
The left job information is cleared from mysql.analyze_jobs.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
The left job information is kept there with running state while show processlist doesn't contain the job.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
nightly
